limitations: Offline NVENC dual-eye H.264 is a VD-like proxy, not an actual Virtual Desktop encode or runnable stock ALVR dual stream.
Panel-raster approximation is not optical centre-density measurement and does not model lenses, distortion, sharpening or the Meta compositor.
Retained control display diagnostics keep their original CPU-only scores and unavailable display HVS; 700 Mbps dual H.264 has no retained display decode.
Display HVS and its reference delta are unavailable for all rows: the qualified HVS scorer needs Vulkan, while additional display analysis is CPU-only.
Fence uses frames 10–89; temporal p99 is luma temporal-delta residual, not optical shimmer or timing. The frozen 90-file-order corpus has 89 distinct payloads.
Runtime rate acceptance, standalone Quest decode budget and sustained live VR are unverified; no default promotion or owner image acceptance follows.
